title: Ride dispatch logging: request context that bleeds between requests
name: Dispatch request logger

questions.prompt: On-call tried to trace one rider's failed booking by filtering the logs on its requestId, and the results made no sense. The "driver assigned" line for that ride carried another rider's requestId and rideId, and the dispatcher's periodic heartbeat lines carried ride ids even though they aren't tied to any ride. It gets worse at peak hours. Fix logger.ts so the tests pass.
